where: paragraph after Théorème 1.2: 'permettent de se débarasser de l'hypothèse (*_l)'
note: Spelling slip of the typescript; the TeX keeps the printed reading. The same slip recurs on p. 8 ('débarasse').

where: Variante 1.4: 'une représentation continue de Gal(eta-bar/eta) dans Gal(n,Q_l)'
note: The target of the representation is the linear group GL(n,Q_l), as in Proposition 1.1 (p. 5); the print types Gal. Same in the DjVu witness. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: after diagram (1.3.1): 'Le groupe Ker(GL(H) -> GL(H/lH)) est un pro-l-groupe'
scan: Ker(GL(H) -> GL(H/lH)): H without the index o, three times
note: In this proof H is the Q_l-space, for which H/lH = 0; the argument concerns the lattice H_o, on which the action is trivial modulo l (preceding sentence). H may be meant as a generic free Z_l-module, so this is only a possible misprint. Same in the DjVu witness. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: paragraph 'La théorie géométrique expliquée ci-dessous ...': 'on peut calquer la théorie transcendance sur la théorie géométrique'
note: Noun typed for the adjective; the same paragraph has 'cette théorie transcendante'. Same in the DjVu witness. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: same paragraph: 'Ce faisant, on se débarasse de nombreux epsilon et eta'
note: Spelling slip (cf. p. 6); the TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: line before (2.2.1): 'Les faisceaux de cycles évanescents psi_i sur X_s sont les'
note: The sheaves are defined in (2.2.1) as psi^i and carry a superscript everywhere else (psi^q in 2.2.3, psi^i on pp. 9-10). The PDF scan and the DjVu witness both have the subscript. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

scan: j_* without a bar (the left-hand side has j-bar_*)
note: Proper base change for the sheaf R^q j-bar_* Lambda gives H^p(X_s, i^* R^q j-bar_* Lambda) = H^p(X_s, psi^q), the E_2 term of (2.2.3). The dot of the j is sharp and there is no bar in the PDF scan or the DjVu witness, so it is not a scan loss. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: Variante 2.6: 'Posons phi^i_gl = H^i_{X_s}(X-bar , Lambda) (analogue global des phi^i)'
note: Wrong index. With phi^q = H^{q+1}_{X_s} (underlined H), the spectral sequence (2.6.1) abuts to H^{p+q+1}_{X_s}(X-bar,Lambda), and in (2.6.2) the term after H^i(X_eta-bar,Lambda) in the exact sequence of the pair (X-bar, X_s) is H^{i+1}_{X_s}(X-bar,Lambda); both need phi^i_gl = H^{i+1}_{X_s}(X-bar,Lambda), the global analogue of phi^i. Same in the DjVu witness. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: Conjecture 3.1: 'un anneau excellent strictement local (0.2) régulier'
note: Wrong reference number in the print: 'strictement local' is defined in (0.0.2), while 0.2 is the paragraph on the Galois action on geometric cohomology. The PDF scan and the DjVu witness both read (0.2). The TeX silently corrects it; the fix restores the printed reading.

The parameter is the small x of 'défini par un paramètre x'; here the print has a capital X (cap height, like A, D, U on the same line). Same in the DjVu witness. The TeX silently corrects it; the fix restores the printed reading.

where: last paragraph: 'défini par une partie d'un système régulier de paramètre'
note: The usual form is 'système régulier de paramètres'. Same in the DjVu witness. The TeX keeps the printed singular.
